label.purpose: Uppercase station names and small labels.

code.purpose: Codes, halt clocks, and tabular figures.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Site chrome only: menus, popovers, the sticky header. The home page adds none.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's main action: ink ground, square, flat.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111318; color: #f7f7f4; padding: 16px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #c9341b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f4fd8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action: ink outline, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #111318; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid #111318; border-radius: 0; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: #111318; color: #f7f7f4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f4fd8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Station Dot
components.description: One stop on the line: 14px, stage-colour border, ground fill.
components.css: .ds-station-dot { display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 3px solid #0b6f63; border-radius: 50%; background: #f7f7f4; }

components.name: Service Notice
components.description: The Robodebt disruption notice: white surface, 2px ink border, square.
components.html:
Service disruption

Robodebt

Correction never arrived. The scheme ran until a court stopped it.
components.css: .ds-notice { background: #ffffff; color: #111318; border: 2px solid #111318; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-notice__label { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-notice__value { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-notice__note { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: #555b66; }

components.name: Newsletter Field
components.description: Square, ink-bordered field that pairs with the primary button.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #ffffff; color: #111318; border: 1px solid #111318; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #555b66; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f4fd8; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The home page draws the seven-stage decision chain as a metropolitan transit diagram: Evidence, Authority, Decision, Consequence, Challenge, Reconsideration, Correction. Robodebt is a service disruption that stops at Consequence; the halt clock reads three years and four months. The visitor marks their own system on the line. The Line is a surface world, scoped to `.home-line` on the home page. The rest of the site keeps the incumbent paper / sapphire / serif editorial system.
keyCharacteristics: The chain is the page; the first viewport is the line.
Colour is data: each stage owns a route colour.
Flat and rule-bound: hairlines, dots, rings, one halt clock.
Citable codes: EVD, AUT, DEC, CON, CHA, REC, COR.
One authored moment: the self-test lights each station and stops at the first gap.

rules.name: The Route Colour Rule
rules.body: On the Line, a saturated colour belongs to a stage or a status, never to a container. A card with a coloured border is not this world.

rules.name: The Chain First Rule
rules.body: The first viewport carries the headline, the Robodebt notice, the primary action, all seven stations, and the legend. A header over a row of cards is not this world.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from hairlines, tonal fills, and the rail. The home page adds no shadow; the only float shadow belongs to site chrome.

dos: Do keep the chain as the page's spine and the first viewport as its thesis.
Do use colour to encode a stage or a status, and keep the station codes citable.
Do keep the halt clock, the Robodebt stop at Consequence, and the legend.
Do keep the self-test on the line; the signal stops at the first gap.
Do keep the mobile rail vertical with the dots on it.
donts: Don't add a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use same-size card grids, nested cards, or a hero-metric template.
Don't use a coloured side stripe on a card or callout.
Don't set prose in mono; mono is for codes, figures, and measurements.
Don't use gradient text, glass decoration, or hard offset shadows.
Don't let the route colours become decoration, and don't apply the Line tokens outside `.home-line`.
